newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank loans cash to local brand-name firms.
newsitem.headline: China bank loans cash to local brand-name firms.

text.p: A Chinese state bank has issued special loans to local companies to help bolster Chinese consumer brand names, the Xinhua news agency reported on Sunday.

Many well-known Chinese consumer brands have come under heavy pressure from foreign brands in recent years, and some have disappeared completely in face of the onslaught of foreign goods in the local consumer market.

The agency said the Shanghai branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China had lent out 361 million yuan to 20 manufacturers, including Shangling Electrical and Shanghai Forever Bicycle, to help them boost sales.
